witness.branch: Crossing outside a crosswalk; disjunctive route alternatives
witness.quote: No pedestrian shall cross a roadway
witness.reason: A travel route may include crossing the road between its curbs without changing the travel task.
required_context: Construct the curb's location, adjacent travel areas and a complete pedestrian crossing route.
Establish a person afoot, the starting and opposite curbs, roadway and shoulder boundaries, and the complete crossing trajectory.
Establish opposite curb and roadway geometry.
Establish that the crossing is outside both crosswalk categories.
Locate marked crossings and intersection-based unmarked crossings to establish the route's relationship to both.
Retain heading, entry and exit points, path length and geometry relevant to both alternative routes: right angles to the curb or the shortest route to the opposite curb.
Retain jurisdiction, highway public dedication/use facts and unresolved municipal applicability of supplied definitions; select no angular tolerance or shortest-route legal method.
Retain pedestrian identity, jurisdiction and highway public-use facts.
witness.subject_reason: Ego is a pedestrian traveling on foot, rather than a vehicle driver near a curb.
